name: object-field-function-pointer-invocation-test-5833b5a158/object-field-function-pointer-invocation-e.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
Expressions: Anonymous function expression; Field access expression; Method call; Call; New expression; Member access expression; Nested expressions (`(expression)`)
Statements: Assignment; Local variable declarations; Return
reason: All constructs are supported. Function-valued class fields initialized with anonymous functions are invoked with positional arguments. The asserted rejections concern excess or missing required arguments, incompatible argument types (including a rest argument), and assigning an int result to string. These are type checking of supported invocations; no named/default argument or langlib restriction applies.
test_design_notes: Negative compilation case with five @error annotations.
The unannotated f.k() call supplies zero rest arguments; its body indexes r[0], but the case asserts compile-time diagnostics rather than executing that call.
